speaker: charlie
text: Now sticking with the ocean theme, it is peak season for the humpback whale migration back down south, and Queensland's coastline is basically a whale highway right now. Researchers out of Queensland are out on the water counting numbers and checking in on mums with new calves.

speaker: alice
text: I saw a pod off Moreton Island last week and honestly Alex, nothing puts your Monday into perspective like a forty tonne animal doing a full breach for no reason other than it can. Scientists reckon these annual counts help them keep tabs on how the population's tracking after decades of recovery.

speaker: charlie
text: Good news story right there, a species that was in real strife last century now cruising past our beaches in the thousands. Grab the binoculars this weekend, headlands from the Gold Coast right up to the Sunshine Coast are all in play.
